mechanism: Methotrexate inhibits dihydrofolate reductase and can impair B12-dependent methylation pathways, while both drugs affect nucleotide metabolism and may increase risk of megaloblastic anemia when B12 is deficient.
action: Monitor B12 levels periodically in patients on methotrexate; consider B12 supplementation if deficiency develops, as methotrexate can increase B12 requirements and mask folate deficiency signs.
